logo.description: Logo configuration for the navigation bar with dynamic options

type.description:
Logo type:
- 'text': Text-based logo with gradient styling
- 'image': Custom image from customImageUrl
- 'github': GitHub profile image with fallback to text
- 'auto': Automatically match home page profileImage settings

text.description: Text to display as logo (used for text type or as fallback)

name.description: Full name to display alongside logo

showName.description: Whether to show the name on desktop

showNameOnMobile.description: Whether to show the name on mobile devices

gradient.description: Tailwind CSS gradient classes for text logo styling

customImageUrl.description: Custom image URL (for image type) or GitHub profile image URL (for github type)

githubUsername.description: GitHub username for fetching profile image (overrides projects.devUsername for navbar only)

imageSize.description: Tailwind CSS size classes for image logo

borderRadius.description: Tailwind CSS border radius class for image logo

name.description: Display name for the navigation item

path.description: URL path for the navigation item

styling.description: Visual styling options for the navbar

scrolledBg.description: Tailwind CSS background classes for navbar when scrolled

transparentBg.description: Tailwind CSS background classes for transparent navbar

activeColor.description: Tailwind CSS text color class for active navigation items

inactiveColor.description: Tailwind CSS text color classes for inactive navigation items

activeTabGradient.description: Tailwind CSS gradient classes for active tab styling

mobileMenuBg.description: Tailwind CSS background class for mobile menu

initialY.description: Initial Y position for navbar animation in pixels

note.description: Documentation note for navbar configuration guidance
